Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-conserve-response-compression
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle contains only metadata and a markdown file (SKILL.md) providing instructions for an AI agent to be more concise and save tokens. It defines rules for removing filler words, hedging language, and conversational framing, which is consistent with its stated purpose of response compression. No code execution, data exfiltration, or malicious prompt injection was found.
